messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: Travis-CI restarts?
parts:
Hi, I recently started doing travis restarts to check packages each
day at the same time. This is beyond each commit/PR/etc. Makes sense
because web APIs can change, so we want to know as soon as possible if
something is broken, and R package dependencies may change w/o us
knowing.

Anyway, here is the repo: https://github.com/ropensci/travis-restarts

It's a tiny Ruby rack app hosted on Heroku that uses the official
Tavis-CI ruby gem and the Heroku scheduler. The scheduler has only 3
possible time frequencies, so you have to do custom scheduling if you
want some specific time. We do once per day, though I think 2x per day
might be better.

Thought you might be interested for ropengov.

Scott
